Marissa / team,

Confirming legal position: Redwood will accept Module 2 (Controller to Processor) of the EU Standard Contractual Clauses for the DataCorp use case (payroll/HR). For UK transfers, we will execute the UK Addendum in combination with Module 2 language (UK Addendum + Module 2 equivalent).

Key notes to communicate to DataCorp (short form for their tracker):
- Role: Redwood = Processor; DataCorp = Controller.
- Module: Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) for both EU and UK (UK Addendum applied for UK-resident data).
- Subprocessors: Redwood maintains a subprocessors list; onward transfers to subprocessors are permitted where governed by our subprocessor terms and with notification. Sensitive categories (eg. payroll PII) are processed under the same technical controls; no additional opt-ins required.
- Common redlines we cannot accept: unilateral termination for incidental subprocessor changes, broad indemnity beyond breach-related liabilities, or permanent deletion obligations incompatible with our retention policy.

I'll draft the DPA/SCC cover text this morning and prepare a DocuSign envelope. Hannah — please confirm SOC2 artifact names I should reference.

-Markus
